title: Section-preserving etale support composition sends nested lifts to composite lifts
statement:
Let h:V→T,e:T→B be separated etale maps and A a commutative ring. Let F,G,H be sheaf functors with inclusions ιh,ιe,ιhe into ordinary direct images, with ιhe injective on every section. Let oh,oe,ohe identify the corresponding sum-extension functors with F,G,H, normalized by their canonical maps into ordinary direct image. If σ:F⋙G≅H preserves sections in composite direct image, the two successive sum-adjunction unit inclusions followed by oh,oe and σ equal the sum-adjunction unit for eh followed by ohe, after the canonical identification of composite test objects.
Conventions and constructions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-etale-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sum-extension].

proof.text: The private Lean lemma unit_comp_toLowerStar proves by the adjunction hom-equivalence that the structural unit followed by the sum-to-direct-image comparison is graph extension. The private lemma unit_comp_normalized_inclusion extends this to the arbitrary support functor and supplied normalized sum isomorphism. Postcompose the desired equation with the injective final support inclusion; substitute the three normalized comparisons and the section-preserving composition equation. Naturality moves the inner sheaf inclusion past the outer graph extension. It remains to compose graph extensions along h and e, with the canonical mapComp identification.

On a nested lift, extending by zero along its inner and outer clopen graphs is extending by zero along the composite graph: both restrictions to the graph are the input section and both restrictions off it are zero. The sheaf axiom gives equality. Addition and sheafification extend from lift generators. The inverse mapComp identifies the test objects. Cancel the final injective inclusion.

theorem etaleSupportNestedSummands
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {V T B : Scheme.{u}} (h : V ⟶ T) (e : T ⟶ B) [Etale h] [Etale e]
    [IsSeparated h] [IsSeparated e]
    (F : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (G : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf B.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (H : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf B.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    (ιh : F ⟶ lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h)
    (ιe : G ⟶ lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e)
    (ιhe : H ⟶ lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (h ≫ e))
    (hi : ∀ (M : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (W : B.Etale),
      Function.Injective ((ιhe.app M).hom.app (Opposite.op W)))
    (oh : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h inferInstance ≅ F)
    (oe : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e inferInstance ≅ G)
    (ohe : etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (h ≫ e) inferInstance ≅ H)
    (nh : ∀ M, oh.hom.app M ≫ ιh.app M =
      etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h M)
    (ne : ∀ M, oe.hom.app M ≫ ιe.app M =
      etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e M)
    (nhe : ∀ M, ohe.hom.app M ≫ ιhe.app M =
      etaleLowerShriekToLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (h ≫ e) M)
    (σ : F ⋙ G ≅ H)
    (nσ : ∀ M, σ.hom.app M ≫ ιhe.app M =
      ιe.app (F.obj M) ≫ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).map (ιh.app M) ≫
        (lowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h e).hom.app M)
    (M : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)) (W : V.Etale) :
          ((etaleLowerShriekRestrictionAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) h).unit.app M).hom.app
              (Opposite.op W) ≫
            (oh.hom.app M).hom.app
              (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale h)).obj W)) ≫
            ((etaleLowerShriekRestrictionAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).unit.app
              (F.obj M)).hom.app
              (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale h)).obj W)) ≫
            (oe.hom.app (F.obj M)).hom.app
              (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale e)).obj
                ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale h)).obj W))) ≫
            (σ.hom.app M).hom.app
              (Opposite.op ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale e)).obj
                ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale h)).obj W))) =
          ((etaleLowerShriekRestrictionAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
              (h ≫ e)).unit.app M).hom.app (Opposite.op W) ≫
            (ohe.hom.app M).hom.app
              (Opposite.op
                ((MorphismProperty.Over.map ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale (h ≫ e))).obj W)) ≫
            (H.obj M).obj.map
              ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapComp ⊤ (inferInstance : Etale h)
                (inferInstance : Etale e)).inv.app W).op
